subject: Private VPC discovery — Acme Health (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Simmons <jared.simmons@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC discovery — Acme Health (post-call recap)

Hi Jared — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our call + proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Pain points you called out:
- Data residency & regulatory: PHI needs to stay in your VPC and meet state-level requirements.
- Network constraints: strict egress rules, only certain subnets allowed for outbound, and no internet egress from the inference hosts in prod.
- Air-gap requirement for the payment-card-adjacent environment (staging can have limited egress).
- Predictable latency for clinical workflows; current vendor spikes are impacting clinician UX.

Goals you want to achieve:
1) Private deployment in your AWS VPC with customer-managed NAT/GW and strict routing controls.
2) Ability to run inference on dedicated hosts (reserved capacity) with deterministic latency SLAs.
3) Clear audit trail: access logs, KMS integration, and SOC2 evidence for internal auditors.

Technical notes we captured:
- We can deploy Redwood Private (VPC integration) into your account and support customer-managed NAT + interface endpoints.
- For the air-gapped environment we recommend an offline bundle + secure data transfer process; we walked through our air-gap playbook at a high level.
- KV/prefix caching will be custodially configurable to avoid sending PHI to any shared layers.

Proposed next steps (owners):
- ACME: Share network diagram + egress rules (Jared / Security team) — target: Tue 4/13
- REDWOOD: Share architecture diagram + SOC2 summary (Marissa) — attached + Drive link
- REDWOOD / ACME: Schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra/security and our deployment engineer (Camila/Dev) — propose Wed 4/14 or Thu 4/15

Attachments: redwood-arch-private-vpc.pdf (deployment overview), soc2-summary-2026.pdf (high-level evidence). I also uploaded these to the shared Drive link below.

If I've missed anything, call it out — otherwise I'll follow up on Mon with available slots for the tech deep-dive.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private VPC discovery — Acme Health (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This matches our notes. A few clarifications from the Security team:
- We'll share a network diagram but note that Prod subnets are fully private; any egress must go through our approved NAT instances.
- For the air-gapped environment: the requirement is that no persistent internet connectivity exists and that bundles are transferred via signed media.
- We will need to validate KMS key policies and will likely require a customer-managed CMK in our account.

I'll send the network diagram and egress rules tomorrow (Mon 4/12). For the tech deep-dive, Thu 4/15 10:00-11:00 PT works for our infra/security leads.

Jared Simmons
Head of Infrastructure, Acme Health
